name: cela-mcp
description: Run tasks in durable, sandboxed agent sessions on a cela deployment through its session API.
long_description: A stdio MCP server for the cela session API. It starts a durable agent session with its own sandbox and workspace, sends it a task and returns the result. It only calls your cela ingest over HTTPS with your token: it has no database access and holds no model or GitHub credential. Read-only admin tools, catalog writes and dangerous admin tools are off unless you turn them on in the settings.

tools.name: run_task
tools.description: Create a session, send a task and wait for the result.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a durable session with its own sandbox.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Queue a message for a session.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for the agent and return its text after a cursor.

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Show a session's status, failure and event counts.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List your own sessions (metadata only), newest first.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Read your own event feed: session and input changes.

tools.name: set_live_view
tools.description: Turn the public view-only live view of a desktop session on or off.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Ask the running turn to stop.

tools.name: delete_session
tools.description: Delete a session and its workspace.

api_url.title: Session API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of your cela ingest, for example https://cela.example.com. Must be https, except for a loopback host such as http://localhost:8080.

api_token.title: Session API token
api_token.description: Your session API token. Kept in the OS keychain. Use the token of an owner who is not an admin.

admin_enabled.title: Enable admin tools
admin_enabled.description: Add read-only admin tools (profiles, skills, MCP servers, egress rule sets and status, settings, catalogs, history, all owners' session list). Needs the admin token below.

admin_token.title: Admin API token
admin_token.description: Admin bearer token, different from the session token. Only used when admin tools are enabled. Kept in the OS keychain.

admin_writes.title: Enable admin writes
admin_writes.description: Add tools that create, change and delete profiles, publish skills, create and change MCP servers and run the network probe. Needs admin tools enabled.

admin_dangerous.title: Enable dangerous admin tools
admin_dangerous.description: Add tools that delete skills and MCP servers, change deployment settings and change egress rules. Needs admin writes enabled.

max_sessions.title: Session limit
max_sessions.description: Most sessions this process may create, so a looping agent cannot start sandboxes without end.
